rows: Technique. Name one hold you have landed on a real opponent.
Brawling is fine. Less talk, more strikes.
Risk is mine to take. Not yours to judge.
Pace is set by me. Not by you.
The people want a contest. Hand them one, now.
Short answer: I run my own career.
I headline because I earn it. Nobody gets that for me.
Look at my footing. Learn it. Nobody holds me up but me.
Technique, you say. Prove it. Show it. Now.
Strikes first. Then the rest. You will feel the order.
Risk without control is noise. Yours is noise.
Stalling. Do not insult me with it.
The people paid. Respect them by wrestling.
You want to be among the best. Do it without stepping over me.
You are proud of your {strength}. Good. Keep going. Be proud in the ring, not in the interview.
I have noted your {strength}. Now prove it.
I could say more. Not a chance.
One fall, plainly. Done. No excuses. Pin me, then.
On the mat, I decide the pace.
Grounded or standing, the choice is mine.
Hold your ground. Let us see.
Acceptable. Move on. Now back it up.
I will fight until the bell. Then I decide what happens next.
My plan is simple: wrestle hard, and do not give anyone a second chance.
Whatever happens, you will know my position.
Nothing is settled. Good. Keep going.
Talking is over. Get in the ring.
